summary: Vaultwarden is a self-hosted password manager server (Rust/Rocket/Diesel reimplementation of the Bitwarden API): it persists users, devices, cipher/vault items with folders/favorites/attachments/archives, organizations with members/collections/groups/policies, sends, emergency access, auth requests, 2FA, and an audit event log, exposing CRUD over the Bitwarden-compatible HTTP API.
